column1: # The evidence pool for the FOLDED byproduct-of-operation value (#102,
# SYNTHESIS.md section 2). Run B found that step 4's placement set could not
# measure it: an environment/suite/reference keyword net cannot select a
# cluster trace, so `provenance-other` came back 0 for structural reasons
# and not as evidence. This file is the sweep that was missing.
# Swept all 2559 names of data_source_names.tsv for trace/telemetry/log/
# most false friends (`network` catches graph datasets, `survey` catches
# astronomical surveys, `grid` catches gridworlds). These are the survivors.
# `family` is RUN A's three sub-cases, recorded so the revisit can see which
# of them the corpus actually supplies. It is NOT a placement: all of these
# now resolve to `human-incidental`, except `system_telemetry`, which has no
# human actor and therefore routes to `provenance-other` -- and that column
# is the count the owner's watch note is about.
# Columns: name, family, papers, contributed, used, referenced
Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care III (MIMIC-III)
